sections.name: File setup, ReminderModule
sections.title: Feature wiring and queue registration
sections.what: Joins the controller, scheduler, worker and notification module into one reminder feature, registers the reminders queue, and exposes the scheduler to other modules.
sections.why: Likely reason: exposing the scheduler lets other parts of the app trigger a scan.
sections.watch_out: Because the scheduler is exported, other modules can call it directly, so any change to scan cost affects them too.

summary: Groups the reminder feature: its routes, its scheduler, its background worker, and the notification module it needs.
purpose: Tells the app how the reminder parts fit together and which queue they share.
why: Likely reason: the framework needs one place that lists controllers, providers and imports for a feature.
how: Registers the reminders queue with default retry and cleanup settings, imports the notification module, lists the controller, scheduler and worker as parts of the feature, and exports only the scheduler.
inputs: None directly. It relies on the queue connection configured elsewhere in the app.
outputs: A module that the main app loads.
risks: The default retry settings here differ from the per-job settings in the scheduler, and the per-job settings win for scheduled jobs. The queue connection is not set in this file, so startup fails if it is missing elsewhere.
debug: If the app fails to start with a message about the reminders queue, check the queue connection settings in the main app. If reminders never arrive, confirm the worker is listed here.
